title: Tasklets: A Unit-Test Benchmark for Language Model Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2611.27607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Tasklets, a benchmark of small synthetic tasks for evaluating the computational capabilities of language model sequence-mixing layers. These tasks probe foundational capabilities such as recall, sequence manipulation, and state tracking. Such tasks are widely used in architecture research, but differences in task selection, formulation, and evaluation make comparisons across studies difficult. Tasklets brings these tasks together, organizing them by the capabilities they test and providing a shared setup for evaluating how different architectural layer types learn fundamental computations. We compare a broad range of layer types through controlled experiments with small models. Our task implementations and evaluation code support reproducible, low-cost testing of new architectural proposals: https://github.com/zaydzuhri/flame/tree/tasklets.

translated_title: Tasklets：面向语言模型架构的单元测试基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Tasklets，这是一个由小型合成任务组成的基准，用于评估语言模型序列混合层的计算能力。这些任务探测回忆、序列操作和状态跟踪等基础能力。此类任务在架构研究中被广泛使用，但任务选择、形式化和评估方面的差异使得跨研究比较变得困难。Tasklets 将这些任务汇集在一起，按其测试的能力进行组织，并为评估不同架构层类型如何学习基本计算提供了统一的设置。我们通过对小型模型的受控实验比较了广泛的层类型。我们的任务实现和评估代码支持对新架构提案进行可重复、低成本的测试。
tldr: Tasklets 是一个由小型合成任务组成的标准化基准，按能力类别（回忆、序列操作、状态跟踪）组织，用于低成本、可重复地评估语言模型序列混合层的基础计算能力。
en_tdlr: Tasklets is a standardized benchmark of small synthetic tasks, organized by capability categories (recall, sequence manipulation, state tracking), enabling reproducible low-cost evaluation of foundational computational abilities in language model sequence-mixing layers.
